name: writing-review
description: Multi-scanner document review that finds clarity issues, structural problems, missing evidence, and AI-written prose, then posts findings as inline comments you can resolve one by one. Paste a doc or browse a file, set the audience and tone, and get a thorough review with proposed fixes.
author: jpontone
highlights: Ten scanners run in parallel covering clarity, structure, evidence, naturalness, and more
Findings appear as inline comments anchored to the exact text so you resolve them one by one
Watson personality: thorough, warm, analytical and explains the reasoning behind every suggestion
Conditional scanners for design docs and emails activate based on document type
Cross-validation catches when scanners conflict and picks the right advice
Chat with the reviewer afterwards to walk through fixes or request rewrites
